Controls & Shortcuts

Tap a structure, then tap the grid
Drag aims the ghost · tap anywhere confirms it
Pinch / two-finger drag
Zoom · pan the camera
× Done chip
Leave the current tool
Click a structure, then click the grid
Place it · repeat to place more
Click / drag empty ground
Select a piece · box-select a group
Shift/⌘+click
Add / remove from selection
Right-click a structure · empty ground
Pick that structure to place more · deselect
Place a FOB first
Each FOB opens a 40×40 build area (areas can't overlap); build inside it
Buildings can't overlap on a floor
Except sandbags, barbed wire, hedgehog & short walls
Drag selection · ←↑↓→
Move · nudge by grid
R / Shift+R
Rotate (snap: 45° · free: 5°) · reverse
F
Mirror / flip selection
⌘/Ctrl+C
Duplicate → reusable stamp
Del / Backspace
Delete selection
WASD / Space-drag / middle-drag
Pan the camera
Scroll
Zoom
[ / ]
Build floor down / up (experimental)
⌘/Ctrl+G · Shift+⌘+G
Group · ungroup the selection
Layers button (top bar)
Z-order, visibility & opacity sheets · Select only touches active layers
Layer row: checkbox · ⌘/Ctrl or Shift-click
Multi-select layers → duplicate / delete / opacity together
Layer row: drag · double-click name
Reorder z-index · rename in place
Go up a floor, then place
Auto-creates a layer for that floor
Board readout (top left)
The stage being built and its piece count · arrows step through the stages · a builder row shows its share of that stage; clicking it makes that builder active and picks out their pieces in this stage, dropping the rest back (click again to undo)
Board readout → pencil
Opens Build Plan: add, rename, recolour, filter or remove stages and builders
Build Plan row: colour dot · double-click name · ×
Recolour the tag · rename · remove it, leaving its pieces on General. The modal only configures tags; what is active and what is hidden are set on the board readout
Board readout: chevron (top right)
Collapse the whole readout to a single chip, and back
Board readout: eye
Hide that stage or builder's pieces from the board
The board shows one stage
Whatever carries the stage on the readout draws normally — each piece in its builder's colour, washed in its stage's colour and hatch. Every other stage drops back without leaving the board
Pick a builder on the readout
Only their work in that stage stays up; pick it again to see every hand
General (stage or builder)
Where work with no tag of its own lives. Selecting it shows the whole build, and a piece left on General stands in every stage's view instead of dropping back
Right-click a piece or selection
Context menu: rotate · mirror · duplicate · delete · group, plus its layer, floor and group. Stage, builder and layer each show what the selection carries now — the pencil turns that line into a picker
Eyedrop tool · right-click → Pick this structure
Adopt a placed piece's type and rotation and carry on placing more of it
Export / Import → Export image
One sheet per stage / builder / stage&builder pair, every PNG the same size and frame
Each sheet carries
Build name & view · a stage/builder badge · the size in blocks · a ruler ticked per block · a legend with counts
A stage sheet reads as a moment
Its own work solid · what is already standing behind it · what comes after, fainter still
Format: PNG files or PDF
PNG gives one file per sheet (or a .zip folder with a build-info.txt) · PDF puts every sheet in one document, a page each, fitted to A4 with a footer
Quality
Pick px-per-block so big bases stay zoomable
⌘/Ctrl+Z · Shift+⌘+Z
Undo · redo
V · B · E
Select · draw · erase tool
G
Toggle snap to grid (Edit → Snap)

Share Code

Share your build: copy the code to post in a thread, or a one-click link that opens the build for anyone. Paste someone else's code below to load it.

Build Plan

A stage says when a piece goes down, a builder says who puts it there. New pieces take whichever of each is active; to re-tag pieces already on the board, right-click them.

Stagewhen it goes down
Builderwho puts it there
A build starts with no stages and no builders — + adds one. Double-click a name to rename it · the colour dot recolours the tag · × removes it and leaves its pieces on General — work with no stage or builder of its own, which shows in every view rather than only its own. Choosing which stage and builder are active, and hiding a tag from the board, are done on the board readout. Export image writes one PNG per stage / builder that has anything built under it.
